topics.title: Voice Changer, Drug Ad & Legal News
topics.summary: A caller discusses using voice changers and the controversy surrounding an advertisement featuring Chris Farley promoting a drug rehabilitation center. Subsequently, news reports detail legal challenges regarding Melissa Drexler’s murder trial and John Glenn's planned return to space for research.

topics.title: Family Tragedy, Iraq Inspections, Tobacco Lawsuits
topics.summary: A father fatally shot his wife and himself in New Jersey, leaving three children orphans. Simultaneously, U.S. inspectors investigating potential chemical weapons sites in Iraq faced continued denial of access by Iraqi officials, while congressional hearings focused on tobacco companies’ alleged targeting of children with advertising.

topics.title: Tobacco Settlement, Unabomber Hearing, Tucker Case
topics.summary: The tobacco industry reached a $4 billion settlement with Texas to address smoking-related healthcare costs. A federal psychiatrist concluded his examination of Ted Kaczynski and predicted competency for trial while Carla Tucker sought clemency from Pat Robertson after claiming religious conversion and influencing public opinion.

topics.title: Restaurant Sanitation & Martian Life Debate
topics.summary: The broadcast begins with a discussion of restaurant sanitation concerns, including rat sightings and improper food handling. Later, participants debate scientific findings regarding past life on Mars, referencing skepticism and "Mars Attacks!", followed by opinions about abortion rights.

topics.title: Broadcast Discusses Online Profile, Legal Cases
topics.summary: A military recruit’s online profile revealing his sexual orientation leads to discharge discussions. The broadcast then covers Paula Jones’ deposition with President Clinton and critiques of her appearance alongside reports on arrests related to the World Trade Center robbery and police shootings in Los Angeles, concluding with news about Norm McDonald's departure from Saturday Night Live.

topics.title: Actors Discuss Marijuana Film and News Events
topics.summary: During a radio broadcast, actors discuss their opinions regarding action versus dramatic roles in films, particularly concerning the portrayal of marijuana within Hollywood. The conversation shifts to unrelated news reports detailing a traffic accident with severe injuries and an assault involving domestic violence, concluding with advertisements for television shows.
